Every internal CRUD app felt like déjà vu.

Auth. Forms. Table views. Wiring databases.
Week after week, of rebuilding the same thing in slightly different ways.

It’s not that the work was hard; it was just... uninspiring.

Then I stumbled on a platform that changed how I think about internal tools.

With Superblocks, you can stitch together real apps fast.
Not no-code fluff. Real APIs. Real logic. Real control.

What surprised me most?
It feels like coding, but without the repetitive scaffolding.

You can write SQL, hit your own APIs, and drop in components.
And when you need a boost, Clark AI is built right into the platform to speed things up.
